target: Cadence RTL verification, intended future SCL180nm implementation
scope: RTL lint and UVM only; no synthesis or physical-design Tcl generated
architecture: Two 64-vector banks, four-lane MAC/activation engine, queued commands, cached autonomous two-layer model and compact result windows
boundary: UVM drives the accelerator CPU-register and host-memory interfaces. CV32 firmware integration is covered separately by the existing tb_streaming regression; this is not full-chip UVM verification.
technology: No SCL180 library is needed for these functional RTL checks. No SCL180 timing, area, power, memory mapping or physical sign-off has been performed.
cadence_requirements: Xcelium xrun on PATH with working licenses
Transfer the Phase2_ RTL source tree while preserving its relative paths
Retain each reports/xcelium_seed_N/uvm.log and its coverage database
Review code coverage and assertion results in IMC before declaring Cadence verification closure

lint.gate: Fail on errors or warning classes other than the four reviewed classes below; preserve every diagnostic in rtl_lint.log
lint.cadence_lint_status: Not run: no Cadence lint installation was available locally. Xcelium simulation/elaboration is not a substitute for a dedicated Cadence lint run.

reviewed_warning_classes.PINCONNECTEMPTY: Unused selected-iteration, queue-occupancy and MAC-idle observation outputs; functional ready/valid and completion connections remain present.
reviewed_warning_classes.GENUNNAMED: Legal unnamed generate blocks; naming/style diagnostic only.
reviewed_warning_classes.UNUSEDSIGNAL: Unused observation/status signals and unused low magnitude bits in the selected top. Retained for shared RTL compatibility; not suppressed in the report.
reviewed_warning_classes.UNUSEDPARAM: Shared package constants unused by this selected hierarchy. Other project hierarchies remain outside this lint top.

uvm.reference: activation_reference_pkg fixed-point arithmetic plus independently computed signed dot products, saturation and Q14-to-Q7 rounding
checks: Frozen 271-example model corpus, all four output lanes and compact lane-zero reads
All four activation modes at fixed 14 iterations
Seeded random signed operands, biases, weights and fused scaling shifts
Queued banks retain captured model weights after register changes
Completion tags, input/output counters, bank release and owned-bank write protection
Unloaded model, invalid lengths, duplicate submission, early release and invalid writes
Partial input writes and rejected partial CPU writes
Reset cancellation during either model layer and recovery
CPU/host control-register decoding and unmapped reads
Adaptive minimum/maximum/full iteration clamps, sampling every result, zero error threshold, qualification and violation controls
Interior and boundary iteration clamp configurations 6, 8, 12, 15 and 16
All 16 host byte-enable masks on both banks, checked through independent linear activation scoreboard
uvm.coverage_limit: 100 percent of these bins does not establish complete RTL code, toggle, branch, assertion, parameter or full-SoC coverage.
uvm.gate: All seeds complete with PASS marker, zero UVM_ERROR/UVM_FATAL, nonempty scoreboard checks and no unreleased bank
uvm.cadence_execution_status: Pending execution on the user's Cadence setup

separate_regressions: tb_mac4_stream: signed extremes, scaling shifts, II=1 and output backpressure
tb_fused_layer: exact outputs, configuration snapshots and counters
tb_stream_job_engine: queue, ownership, IRQ and reset
tb_command_queue: ordered transfers at depths 1, 3 and 4
tb_stream_learning: adaptive controller state, sampling and freeze
tb_autonomous_model: frozen expected outputs and all 65536 requantization inputs
tb_streaming: CV32 firmware integration and legacy compatibility
fpga_artifact_provenance: The board-tested bitstream remains unchanged. Explicit-width lint corrections create a newer RTL revision; the FPGA build manifest retains the original RTL source hashes. No rebuild is needed to repeat the recorded board experiment using the retained bitstream.

code_coverage.status: Full closure incomplete; statement, branch and condition coverage measured locally
code_coverage.reproduction: run_uvm_local.ps1 -CodeCoverage runs seeds 1,7,23, merges databases, archives evidence, then removes its generated work directory
code_coverage.toggle_limitation: Vivado/XCRG 2023.2 Windows access violation while reporting toggle-instrumented design; sbc reporting succeeds. Baseline sbct database preserved in coverage_baseline.zip.

scope_constraints_for_lab_review.reason: stream_mmio resets cfg.lut_reset to zero and exposes no write to set it; LUT-reset statements are unreachable through this production top. Existing standalone learning test exercises this interface separately.
Invalid LANES fatal guard cannot execute with fixed LANES=4.
Invalid-width fatal guard cannot execute with the legal instantiated widths.
Invalid DEPTH/WIDTH predicates are constant false for this instance.
Two-bit lane indices cannot exceed three when LANES=4.
The enclosing qualification controller clamps accepted iteration counts to 6..16; input clamp branches outside 1..16 are unreachable at this boundary.
Autonomous hidden values come from Q14 tanh in [-16384,16383], so requant cannot produce a value below -128. The general helper clamp is retained.

remaining_review: Instance-level branch and condition holes, including short-circuit/constant predicates
CORDIC saturation and divider-zero reachability proofs before any numerical exclusions
Toggle reporting and Cadence Xcelium/IMC rerun in lab
code_coverage.scope_warning: A standalone module test does not automatically close a production-top instance bin. No blanket exclusions applied.

intended_end_use.asic: Accelerator/IP only; no CV32 or firmware in ASIC source manifests
intended_end_use.fpga: CV32 processor, firmware and board integration control/test the accelerator
intended_end_use.physical_boundary: stream_mmio is the verified digital interface. Off-chip transport, chip wrapper, pads and SCL180 clock/reset/memory mapping are not yet finalized. Existing npu_spi_top is a legacy transport, not a verified autonomous stream_mmio chip wrapper.
